onChange.calculateFunc: (data.routes || []).filter(r => String(r.market || '') === String(data.routeMarketFilter || '')).sort((a, b) => (Number(a.order) || 9999) - (Number(b.order) || 9999)).map((r, i) => ({ category: r.category, order: (i + 1) * 10 }))

(() => { const market = String(data.routeMarketFilter || ''); if (!market) return data.routes || []; const kept = (data.routes || []).filter(r => String(r.market || '') !== market); const edited = (data.routeEditorRows || []).map((r, i) => ({ market, category: r.category, order: (i + 1) * 10 })); return kept.concat(edited); })()
